UI.Title: FIRST AID QUIZ
UI.Question: QUESTION %1/%2
UI.Q1: WHICH BLEEDING WOUND LOSES BLOOD FASTEST?
UI.Q1R: THE NECK BLEEDS THREE TIMES AS FAST AS AN ARM. THE HEAD, THIGH AND GROIN HALF AS FAST AGAIN.
UI.Q2: A CLEAN BANDAGE ON A BLEED CUTS THE BLOOD YOU LOSE TO...
UI.Q2R: A FRESH BANDAGE SLOWS A BLEED TO A TENTH. ONLY STITCHES STOP A DEEP ONE.
UI.Q3: YOUR BANDAGE IS SOAKED THROUGH. HOW WELL DOES IT STILL SLOW THE BLEED?
UI.Q3B: AS WELL AS A NEW ONE
UI.Q3R: A SPENT BANDAGE ONLY HALVES A BLEED AND INVITES INFECTION. CHANGE IT.
UI.Q4: A SHARD OF GLASS IS STILL IN THE WOUND. WHAT HAPPENS UNDER A BANDAGE?
UI.Q4R: A SHARD OR BULLET LEFT IN BLEEDS THROUGH THE DRESSING AND HOLDS THE WOUND OPEN. GET IT OUT.
UI.Q5: ABOUT HOW LONG DOES A BANDAGE LAST BEFORE IT IS SPENT?
UI.Q5C: AS LONG AS IT STAYS ON
UI.Q5R: A BANDAGE WEARS OUT OVER ABOUT A DAY, FASTER WET AND FASTER STILL SOAKING UP BLOOD.
UI.Q6: WHAT ACTUALLY STOPS A DEEP WOUND BLEEDING?
UI.Q6R: A BANDAGE ONLY SLOWS IT. LEFT UNSTITCHED, A DEEP WOUND HEALS AT A THIRD OF THE SPEED.
UI.Q7: YOU PACK CLOTTING POWDER INTO A BLEEDING CUT. WHAT DOES IT DO?
UI.Q7R: PACKED INTO A SCRATCH OR A CUT, IT STOPS THE BLEEDING THERE AND THEN. IT STINGS.
UI.Q8: CLOTTING POWDER IS PACKED INTO A DEEP WOUND. WHAT ELSE DOES IT NEED?
UI.Q8R: THE CLOT CUTS ITS BLEED TO A QUARTER FOR UP TO 12 HOURS, BUT A DEEP WOUND STILL WANTS STITCHES.
UI.Q9: YOUR LEG WAS JUST STITCHED. WHAT CAN TEAR THE FRESH STITCHES?
UI.Q9R: RUNNING ON A STITCHED LEG OR SWINGING A STITCHED ARM CAN TEAR THEM. THEY HOLD ONCE THEY ARE SOUND.
UI.Q10: ROUGH STITCHES, LEFT AS THEY ARE, WILL...
UI.Q10R: THEY KNIT AT HALF SPEED, TEAR TWICE AS EASILY, HURT AND LET INFECTION IN. TAKE THEM OUT, STITCH AGAIN.
UI.Q11: YOUR LEG IS BROKEN AND HAS NO SPLINT. WHAT DOES WALKING ON IT DO?
UI.Q11R: MOVING ON AN UNSPLINTED BROKEN LEG ADDS TO THE BREAK EVERY HOUR. SPLINT IT FIRST.
UI.Q12: WHY DOES FIRST AID SKILL MATTER WHEN SETTING A SPLINT?
UI.Q12A: A BAD SET HEALS HALF AS FAST
UI.Q12R: SETTING A BONE IS A FIRST AID ROLL. SET BADLY, IT HEALS AT HALF SPEED AND HURTS MORE. RESET IT.
UI.Q13: A WOUND WAS JUST CONTAMINATED. WHAT CLEARS IT COMPLETELY?
UI.Q13R: AN INFECTION HIDES FOR 8 TO 16 HOURS BEFORE IT SHOWS. CLEANING THE WOUND THEN ENDS IT.
UI.Q14: WHICH DRESSING, WHILE FRESH, LETS NO INFECTION IN AT ALL?
UI.Q14B: A RAG TORN FROM A SHIRT
UI.Q14R: A FRESH STERILIZED BANDAGE KEEPS INFECTION OUT. A SPENT ONE TRIPLES THE RISK.
UI.Q15: LEFT OPEN AND UNWASHED, WHICH WOUND GETS INFECTED MOST EASILY?
UI.Q15R: A BITE OR A SHARD LEFT IN IS WORST, THEN A DEEP WOUND, A BURN, A CUT AND A SCRATCH.
UI.Q16: THE INFECTION HAS SPREAD AND YOU HAVE A FEVER. WHAT TREATS IT NOW?
UI.Q16R: ONCE IT IS IN THE BODY ONLY ANTIBIOTICS TOUCH IT. CLEANING ONLY HELPS BEFORE IT SPREADS.
UI.Q17: YOU FEEL BETTER AND STOP THE ANTIBIOTICS AFTER FOUR PILLS. WHAT MIGHT HAPPEN?
UI.Q17R: STOPPED BEFORE TEN DOSES, IT HAS A COIN FLIP TO RETURN INSIDE, WHERE ONLY ANTIBIOTICS REACH IT.
UI.Q18: AN INFECTION TURNS INTO SEPSIS. UNTREATED, ABOUT HOW LONG DO YOU HAVE?
UI.Q18R: SEPSIS BRINGS A HIGH FEVER AND DRAINS HEALTH FASTER THE WORSE IT GETS. GET ANTIBIOTICS IN.
UI.Q19: AFTER A FALL YOU HAVE A HEADACHE AND FEEL DROWSY. WHAT IS IT?
UI.Q19R: A MILD CONCUSSION IS A HEADACHE AND DROWSINESS. NAUSEA AND LIGHT THAT HURTS MEAN A WORSE ONE.
UI.Q20B: A RUN TO CLEAR YOUR HEAD
UI.Q20R: REST HEALS IT AND SLEEP TWICE AS FAST. RUNNING, SPRINTING AND FIGHTING STOP IT HEALING.
UI.Q21: CONCUSSED, YOU PLAY YOUR SPIFFBOY. WHAT DOES THE SCREEN DO?
UI.Q21R: SCREEN TIME HEALS A CONCUSSION AT HALF SPEED, AND WITH A BAD ONE IT MAKES YOUR HEAD HURT.
UI.Q22: WHAT MAKES A KNOCK TO THE HEAD LESS LIKELY TO CONCUSS YOU?
UI.Q22R: A HELMET MAKES A CONCUSSION LESS LIKELY, AND LESS BAD WHEN IT DOES HAPPEN.
UI.Q23: WHAT IS THE FIRST SIGN THAT YOU HAVE LOST A LOT OF BLOOD?
UI.Q23R: A SIXTH OF YOUR BLOOD GONE LEAVES YOU PALE AND WEAK. MORE BRINGS DIZZINESS, THEN SHOCK.
UI.Q24: IN SHOCK FROM BLOOD LOSS, WHAT CAN HAPPEN WITHOUT WARNING?
UI.Q24R: IN SHOCK THERE IS A CHANCE EACH MINUTE OF PASSING OUT FOR 5 TO 15 MINUTES, MORE AS YOU BLEED OUT.
UI.Q25: WHAT DOES YOUR BODY NEED TO REFILL THE BLOOD IT LOST?
UI.Q25R: THE VOLUME COMES BACK IN ABOUT A DAY, BUT ONLY WITH ENOUGH WATER. RED CELLS TAKE ABOUT A WEEK.
UI.Q26: YOU FAINTED, AND A ZOMBIE SCRATCHES YOU. WHAT HAPPENS?
UI.Q26R: A FAINT IS SHALLOW: A NEW WOUND WAKES YOU. A KNOCKOUT FROM A CONCUSSION IS NOT.
UI.Q27: ABOUT HOW LONG DOES A PAINKILLER PILL HOLD THE PAIN OFF?
UI.Q27R: A PAINKILLER CLEARS PAIN WHILE IT WORKS, ABOUT 45 GAME MINUTES. THEN THE PAIN COMES BACK.
UI.Q28: HOW MANY PAINKILLERS TAKEN TOGETHER IS AN OVERDOSE?
UI.Q28R: FOUR OR MORE CLOSE TOGETHER IS TOO MUCH, AND MEANS HOURS OF NAUSEA.
UI.Q29: WHAT DOES SUMATRIPTAN DO TAKEN DURING A MIGRAINE ATTACK?
UI.Q29R: IT ENDS THE ATTACK WITHIN TWO HOURS AND HALVES THE PAIN MEANWHILE. IN THE AURA, IT HALVES THE ATTACK.
UI.Q30: WHY ARE ORDINARY PAINKILLERS POOR FOR A MIGRAINE?
UI.Q30R: IN AN ATTACK A PAINKILLER'S RELIEF LASTS ABOUT A THIRD AS LONG. SUMATRIPTAN IS WHAT WORKS.
UI.Q31: HOW OFTEN DOES AN EPILEPTIC TAKE ANTICONVULSANTS?
UI.Q31R: A PILL EVERY 12 HOURS. OVER FIVE DAYS THEY BUILD UP AND SEIZURES BECOME A TENTH AS LIKELY.
UI.Q32: AN EPILEPTIC FEELS THE WARNING OF A SEIZURE. WHAT SHOULD THEY DO?
UI.Q32R: THE AURA GIVES 5 TO 10 MINUTES: STOP THE CAR, LEAVE THE FIGHT. THEN YOU DROP WHAT YOU HOLD AND GO DOWN.
UI.Q33: HOW SOON DOES A DOSE OF INSULIN START TO WORK?
UI.Q33R: IT STARTS AFTER 15 MINUTES, PEAKS AT ABOUT 75 AND IS SPENT BY 4 HOURS. TOO MUCH SENDS YOU LOW.
UI.Q34: A DIABETIC'S BLOOD SUGAR IS LOW. WHAT BRINGS IT UP FASTEST?
UI.Q34R: FAST SUGARS (SODA, CANDY, FRUIT) HIT WITHIN HALF AN HOUR. BREAD AND PASTA TAKE ABOUT TWO HOURS.
UI.Q35: WHAT DO DAILY BETA BLOCKERS DO FOR A HEART CONDITION?
UI.Q35R: A PILL A DAY, BUILT UP OVER 3 DAYS: STRAIN BUILDS HALF AS FAST, A HEART ATTACK IS HALF AS LIKELY.
UI.Q36: CHEST PAIN HITS A HEART PATIENT. WHAT ENDS IT WITHIN A MINUTE?
UI.Q36R: A TABLET UNDER THE TONGUE ENDS IT. TWO WITHIN AN HOUR DROP THE BLOOD PRESSURE: YOU FAINT.
UI.Q37: ON ANTIDEPRESSANTS FOR MDD, WHEN DO THEY WORK FULLY?
UI.Q37R: EACH PILL COVERS A DAY. THE BENEFIT BUILDS OVER THREE UNBROKEN DAYS; TAKEN DRUNK, A PILL COUNTS HALF.
UI.Q38: YOU HAVE BEEN THIRSTY FOR HOURS. WHAT DOES DEHYDRATION BRING?
UI.Q38R: HOURS AT THIRSTY OR WORSE BRING A HEADACHE, TIREDNESS AND SLOW BREATH. DRINK AND IT GOES IN TWO HOURS.
UI.Q39: ABOUT HOW LONG IN FULL SUMMER SUN BURNS BARE SKIN?
UI.Q39R: ABOUT THREE HOURS OF MIDDAY SUN BURNS BARE SKIN. IT IS STRONGEST FROM 11 TO 3. COVER UP.
UI.Q40: WHAT DOES SUN BLOCK DO FOR A SUNBURN YOU ALREADY HAVE?
UI.Q40R: ONE COAT KEEPS THE SUN OFF BARE SKIN FOR 8 HOURS, BUT A BURN ONLY HEALS WITH TIME: ABOUT A DAY.
